# Stored resources regression

Unmodified native-width comparison fixture from zpl-comparison:
`test-data/external-zpl/cases/zplr-stored-resources-native-width.zpl`.
Derived from MIT-licensed le2ni/zplr revision
1c94eadfc5afb494b4c92dd10ad4808bd3d19529, fixtures/stored-resources.zpl.
The adjacent LICENSE retains its upstream notice. Comparison adaptations are
an explicit 448x220 canvas and isolated RAM names R:CMPEX.GRF/R:CMPEX.ZPL.
The regression compares the recalled scene with the equivalent inline content,
including the downloaded graphic and numbered field SESSION-42.
